An '''armor platoon''' was a formation in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Armor [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] generally fielded between thirty-four and forty-two men, spread between either four heavy vehicles&mdash;each staffed by four- or five-man crews&mdash;or eight medium or light vehicles, with a three man crew apiece. An additional vehicle, the command vehicle, was generally a medium vehicle modified with a secondary gun cupola mounting a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]]. The heavy vehicle configuration was the most common.<ref name="ISB" />

Armor platoons also incorporated two [[Heavy Transport Vehicle|heavy transport vehicles]] which carried spare parts and supplies for the platoon. Each HTV was staffed by a three-man crew who doubled as mechanics, and a staff of four [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. These technicians were familiar with the workings of each vehicle under their care, but each technician specialized in a certain field; weapons systems, armor maintenance, control circuits, and engine/power transmission. The vehicles of an armor platoon were generally [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsorlift tanks]], but some units employed [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] or other heavy vehicles.<ref name="ISB" /> Walkers were intended to give armor platoons a non-repulsorlift option for their heavy assault vehicles.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

A platoon of four [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] could be transported into battle via the use of [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] [[Warlord Dropship]]s<ref name="AWTC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref> or [[Incom Corporation]] [[Y-85 Titan dropship]]s.<ref name="ITW:OT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
